title: Memoir presented to the Royal Academy of Sciences, October 2, 1820, on the effects of electric currents
version: Modern English translation hosted by Princeton’s Joseph Henry Project; translator and translation method not identified in inspected PDF.
lineage: Primary text in a modern, unattributed translation. Core result independently corroborated by NIST; no exact day of the two-wire test inferred from the composite memoir.

passages.note: PDF p. 1 title: October 2 memoir includes September 18 and 25 presentations.
§1 and §4 (PDF pp. 1, 4–5): Ørsted’s experiment; parallel conductors connected to two voltaic piles; attraction/repulsion.
